data.description: As a full-round action, a shulsaga that touches a silver cord (such as that created by the spell astral projection) can cause the cord to recoil. The astral projecting creature must succeed at a DC %1 Will saving throw or be snapped back to its body, ending the spell effect but not harming the spellcaster.
data.name: Astral Recoil
